lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, approximately circular spot centroids arranged in a grid-like configuration. Vertical spacing between spots is roughly 1.5 to 2 times the spot diameter, while horizontal spacing between columns appears consistent across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Primary high-intensity blobs are positioned at the intersection points of faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and horizontal planes, creating a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a distinct linear highlight on the superior edge and a corresponding shadow on the inferior edge, indicating structural elevation.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance biological entities (consistent with remora attachment) located ventrally to the lateral midline and posterior to the pectoral fin.
